about: Test fixture with the shape of recall_long.json at a small scale: two slice installers and an order system distributor on the shipment records (tier 1), order system accounts (tier 2) and a building owner named by a claim (tier 3) in the directory, a long-run schedule. All phone numbers are fictional 555-01xx numbers.
